# std/sync API

## Overview
This page lists the public API of module `std/sync` (declaration-only syntax), organized by free functions, traits, types, and given implementations.

Import the module with `using "std/sync" { ... };`.

## Free Functions
```koral
/// 类型安全的消息传递通道工厂。
/// 返回 (SendChannel, RecvChannel) 对，避免统一 Channel 类型带来的误用。
/// 通道是有界的：队列达到 `capacity` 时 send() 阻塞。
/// capacity 为 0 时是无缓冲的会合通道（rendezvous）：send() 阻塞到某个
/// 接收方取走该消息才返回，用于严格的交接与同步场景。
public let make_channel[T: Any](capacity: UInt): Pair[SendChannel[T], RecvChannel[T]];
```

## Types
```koral
/// 原子布尔，用于标志位和开关
/// 所有操作使用顺序一致性内存序
/// Sendable contract: self-synchronized -- every operation is one atomic
/// FFI step (seq_cst), interior mutation bypasses object locks by design.
public type unsafe sendable mutable AtomicBool;

/// 原子有符号整数（Int，平台相关宽度），支持无锁的原子读写和 CAS 操作
/// 所有操作使用顺序一致性内存序
public type unsafe sendable mutable AtomicInt;

/// 原子无符号整数（UInt，平台相关宽度），支持无锁的原子读写和 CAS 操作
/// 所有操作使用顺序一致性内存序
public type unsafe sendable mutable AtomicUInt;

/// One shared `sendable` value with atomic access: every operation is a
/// single linearizable step. `update_and_get` runs a combining lambda
/// optimistically (no lock across the lambda), which is where cross-thread
/// read-modify-write belongs now that `+=` is two non-atomic steps. Sendable
/// contract: self-synchronized.
public type unsafe sendable mutable AtomicCell[T: sendable];

/// The sending half of a bounded channel; dropping it closes the channel for receivers.
public type unsafe sendable mutable SendChannel[T: Any];

/// The receiving half of a bounded channel; dropping it closes the channel for senders.
public type unsafe sendable mutable RecvChannel[T: Any];

/// Countdown gate that opens once every latch has been removed.
public type unsafe sendable mutable LatchGate;

/// Thread-safe lazy value whose initializer runs at most once.
/// Sendable contract: self-synchronized -- the state machine runs the
/// initializer at most once; `get` from any thread is safe.
public type unsafe sendable mutable Lazy[T: Any];

/// A bare mutex lock that protects whatever shared data the caller guards between `lock` and `unlock`.
/// Sendable contract: self-synchronized -- `lock`/`unlock` are the
/// programmer's critical-section discipline over shared state.
public type unsafe sendable mutable Mutex;

/// Condition variable bound to a `Mutex` for waiting on shared-state changes.
public type unsafe sendable mutable MutexCondvar;

/// Classic counting semaphore: `acquire` decrements the permit count (blocking
/// at zero) and `release` increments it unconditionally, exactly as in the
/// Dijkstra P/V discipline. The count is not capped, so releases may outnumber
/// acquires — that is a legitimate way to pre-load wake-ups for later waits.
public type unsafe sendable mutable Semaphore;

/// Reader-writer lock with exclusive `lock` and shared `lock_shared` modes.
/// Writer preference is provided on Linux (glibc); on other platforms readers
/// may barge ahead of a waiting writer.
public type unsafe sendable mutable SharedMutex;

/// Condition variable bound to a `SharedMutex`'s exclusive mode.
public type unsafe sendable mutable SharedMutexCondvar;
```

/// The cell's linearizable operations: construction, atomic read/write,
/// swap, and the combining `update_and_get`.
given[T: sendable] AtomicCell[T] {
    /// Create a cell holding `initial`.
    public new(initial: T): AtomicCell[T];
    /// Atomically read the current value.
    public get(self): T;
    /// Atomically replace the stored value. The old value is released after
    /// the unlock.
    public set(self, value: T): Void;
    /// Atomically replace the stored value and return the previous one. The
    /// old value is released after the unlock.
    public swap(self, value: T): T;
    /// Atomically read-modify-write: apply `f` to the current value, store
    /// the result, and return the NEW value. The whole step is one
    /// linearizable operation -- this is the home of
    /// `counter.update_and_get(n => n + 1)`.
    ///
    /// Optimistic: `f` runs with NO lock held, against a snapshot. The result
    /// is committed only when nobody else wrote in between; otherwise the
    /// snapshot is taken again and `f` runs again. `f` may therefore run more
    /// than once and must not have side effects outside the cell. `f` must not
    /// write the cell it updates -- every attempt would be invalidated and the
    /// loop would give up with a panic instead of spinning forever. Reading the
    /// cell inside `f` is fine.
    public update_and_get(self, f: (T) -> T): T;
};

/// Equality-gated operations: `compare_exchange` compares by `Eq` value
/// equality (not pointer identity).
given[T: Eq and sendable] AtomicCell[T] {
    /// Atomically replace the value with `desired` when it currently equals
    /// `expected`; report whether the exchange happened. Equality is `Eq`
    /// value equality, not pointer identity. The old value is released after
    /// the unlock.
    public compare_exchange(self, expected: T, desired: T): Bool;
};

    public send(self, value: T): Result[Void];

    /// Add `count` more latches to the gate.

given[T: Any] Lazy[T] {
    /// Wrap `f` so it runs at most once, on the first `get`.
    public new(f: sendable () -> T): Lazy[T];
    /// Return the value, running and caching the initializer on first use.
    ///
    /// The initializer runs with no lock held, so it may call other lazy
    /// values, globals and locks without lock-ordering deadlocks. It must not
    /// call `get()` on the same `Lazy`: there is no value to return yet, and
    /// that mistake panics with a diagnostic instead of hanging.
    public get(self): T;
    /// Check whether the initializer has already run.

};

/// Locks and unlocks the mutex and creates its condition variables.
given Mutex {
    /// 创建互斥锁
    public new(): Mutex;
    /// 获取锁（阻塞直到成功）
    /// 锁不可重入：已持有锁的线程再次调用 lock() 会死锁（底层是非递归锁）
    public lock(self): Void;
    /// 尝试获取锁（非阻塞），成功返回 true，锁被占用返回 false
    public try_lock(self): Bool;
    /// 释放锁
    public unlock(self): Void;
    /// 创建绑定到此互斥锁的条件变量
    public condvar(self): MutexCondvar;
};

/// Waits for and sends notifications while holding the bound mutex.
given MutexCondvar {
    /// 释放绑定的 Mutex 并等待通知，被唤醒后重新获取 Mutex
    /// 调用前必须持有绑定的 Mutex，否则行为未定义
    /// 返回前重新获取的仍是同一把非递归锁：等待期间不要再以其它途径持有它
    /// 注意：必须在 while 循环中检查条件谓词（防止虚假唤醒）
    public wait(self): Void;
    /// 唤醒一个等待中的线程
    public notify(self): Void;
    /// 唤醒所有等待中的线程
    public notify_all(self): Void;
};

/// Creates the semaphore and takes and returns permits.
given Semaphore {
    /// Create a semaphore with `permits` permits available.
    public new(permits: UInt): Semaphore;
    /// Take a permit, blocking until one is available.
    public acquire(self): Void;
    /// Take a permit only if one is immediately available.
    public try_acquire(self): Bool;
    /// Return a permit and wake one waiting thread.
    /// Unconditional: the permit count grows even past what `acquire` has taken,
    /// so `release` never fails and never panics.
    public release(self): Void;
};

};
